title: Bearing / vibration anomaly on PUMP-204 drive end
description: Drive-end vibration trending up sharply since Sunday night; bearing temperature elevated. Recent maintenance work-order replaced the seal but the alignment check is NOT documented on Form QA-MAINT-04A.

title: Outlet temperature drift on HX-307 over 3 days
description: Outlet temperature has drifted 6 C above spec across the last 3 batches. Flow trending down. Quality flagged 25.8 % rejection rate on B-201; customer notification pending. Suspect tube-side fouling.

title: Electrical anomaly on MTR-512 — safety escalation
description: Phase current imbalance climbed from 4 % to 8.7 % over the week; winding temperature now exceeds nameplate. Operator reported a faint burning smell during the swing shift. Batch B-215 quarantined for electrical safety review.
